title: MusicLib
description: An Android application built with Android Studio and Kotlin for short-form content creators. It provides 60-second background music tracks and features AI-powered music generation for creating custom 30-60 second tracks in the premium version.

title: Blithchron'26 App
description: A React Native application for cross-platform mobile development with React for the annual cultural fest of IIT Gandhinagar, Blithchron'26. I was the Lead Frontend Developer for this project.
